brief.title: Discovery call — Usage-based billing & invoicing platform — 25 Feb 2026
business_goals: Customers need real-time visibility into their own usage — API calls consumed so far this billing period, ideally updated within a few minutes, not just at month end.
We already emit metering events to a Kafka topic — the billing system needs to consume from that topic rather than us building a second metering layer.
The system has to calculate tiered charges correctly, we cannot get this wrong, it directly hits revenue recognition.
We also want usage alerts — ideally customers get notified by email when they hit 80% of any spending cap they've set for themselves.
constraints: Customers need real-time visibility into their own usage — API calls consumed so far this billing period, ideally updated within a few minutes, not just at month end.
For scale, our biggest customer alone generates about 40 million API calls a month.
Dunning and failed-payment retry logic should ideally be automatic — retry a failed card three times over a week before flagging the account to a human.
open_questions: Which metric defines success for launch?
